config.claim_boundary: Target-free integration test of a source-frozen visual-hull support cloud used only for exact persistence after Splat reconstruction failure. It is not a physical-twin, absolute-accuracy, calibration, or state-of-the-art evaluation.

scoring_boundary.paired_candidate_minus_baseline_regret: Provably zero for any deterministic metric because the complete trajectories are bit-identical.
scoring_boundary.absolute_identity_rmse: Not available: visual-hull points do not inherit official Splat material identities.
scoring_boundary.absolute_chamfer: Requires a separately declared variable-cardinality target protocol and is not evaluated here.
scoring_boundary.prospective_use: A future protocol may count persistence-only cases as exact non-regression ties, but not as absolute-accuracy or calibration observations.
